reviewRole: independent gameplay-programmer, canon, systems, and determinism review
mode: read-only review of the single retained production attempt; no query, staging, advance, simulation, test, build, package, campaign, source edit, tuning, threshold change, or retry
summary: The corrected-start diagnostic proved lawful directive admission, normal 25 CA consumption, a soft objection override, operation creation, and two physical roster movements. It did not prove operation-owned combat or capture. The operation stayed in planning, the opening-attack executable predicate returned false, and the lifecycle retired it with recovery_reason zero_eligible_axis after the fixed planning grace expired.

inputAndRuntime.sourceBindingAssessment: RESULT.json binds the production consumer, staging path, directive planner, enclave eligibility source, formatter, tests, and harness helpers to the recorded head. The later unrelated working-tree edit to tests/scenario_runner_artifact_repair.test.ts occurred after this retained attempt and does not alter these bound bytes or the desktop advance path.

legalityEvidence.assessment: The seven-member roster was lawfully admitted by the corrected harness using the unchanged production objective-eligibility predicate. The three formations below the later 500-person offensive-action floor were still legal directive selections; that floor is an opening-attack guard, not the repaired admission rule.

commandAuthorityAndOverride.assessment: The public objection was advisory and the permitted soft override staged the normal target/corps request. No force_launch option or hard-guard bypass was supplied. was_force_launched records the political override consequence; force_launch was absent until serialized false in recovery and therefore did not bypass launch readiness.

movement.assessment: Movement and staging participation are proven. They are not evidence of an attack.

preparation.assessment: Preparation reached ready and recommended launch. No preparation abort, manual termination, or defender_power_too_high recovery occurred.

supply.assessment: The operation-level readiness value persisted as 1 and the preparation events also reported 1. Supply was not the lifecycle blocker recorded by this attempt.

assemblyAndAttackFloor.assessment: The returned blocker is downstream of the assembly and attack-floor checks. The active, undisrupted 600-person main brigade passed the canonical offensive-action floor.

approachAndAdjacency.assessment: The retained input identifies both positions as RBiH-controlled neighbors of Obadi; the 600-person main brigade was at Ljeskovik and other 600-person assigned brigades were also on those positions. The engine did not emit no_approach_osid.

predictor.exactPredicate: No considered opening attack returned an outcome sufficient for the costly_victory threshold, including the concentrated-outcome alternative; the helper therefore returned false and classifyAxisOpeningAttack persisted zero_eligible_axis.
predictor.subtypeReason: launch_blocker_detail and launch_readiness_detail are absent because the opt-in axis_reject reason-code topic was not enabled. The persisted default-run field deliberately collapses predictor-no-candidate and predictor-candidate-below-threshold into zero_eligible_axis. No post-hoc rerun is authorized, so this review does not label it present_too_weak or not_reachable_from_position.
predictor.notAForceRatioContradiction: Preparation force_ratio_estimate is a planning assessment. Opening executability uses the combat predictor and the operation's min_attack_outcome, defaulting here to costly_victory. A preparation estimate of 1 or 3 does not itself satisfy that predicate.

lifecycle.assessment: At turn 25, force_launch was not true and the fixed planning deadline had expired. evaluateOpeningAttackReadiness returned non-executable, so beginRecovery wrote zero_eligible_axis before another preparation tick or any planning-to-execution transition.

combatAndControl.assessment: Other battles occurred in the world, but none belonged to this operation. Obadi remained under RS control and there is no capture lineage.

sourceTraceAtRecordedHead.fact: The default planning attack threshold is costly_victory; opening executability requires a direct or concentrated predicted outcome sufficient for that threshold.
Axis classification checks approach, optional assembly, attack floor, and then the opening-attack predicate; a false predicate is persisted as zero_eligible_axis.
Detailed dead-axis/not-reachable/present-too-weak facts are written only when the axis_reject reason-code topic is enabled.
After planning_duration plus grace, a non-force_launch operation enters recovery when opening readiness remains non-executable.

retainedV1_1Failure.meaning: The v1.1 attempt remains a harness false rejection after one completed advance and lacks raw state/report evidence. V2 answers the corrected legal-roster and raw-boundary question; it does not retroactively turn v1.1 into a capability result.

claimLimits: This is a negative fixed-window capability result: the Obadi capture criterion is unmet.
It proves no operation-owned combat, no attack resolution, and no capture of Obadi.
It makes no claim about a different player strategy, a longer window, a combined Bukvik-plus-Obadi strategy, January 1995, score 707, the native/package UI path, or historical capture.
It does not diagnose a gameplay defect or recommend a fix. The normal combat predictor and hard launch-readiness guards rejected this admitted operation in the retained state.
No rerun, alternate roster, threshold reduction, tuning, forced control change, teleport, or strategy shopping is authorized or implied by this review.
reviewConclusion: BLOCK capability/calibration qualification for Obadi. Preserve the lawful-delivery proof and the negative outcome together: seven eligible uncommitted formations were admitted, 25 CA was spent, two formations physically moved, preparation reached ready, but the opening-attack predictor never supplied an outcome sufficient for costly_victory before the fixed deadline. The exact persisted blocker is zero_eligible_axis; its optional fine-grained subtype was not recorded and remains unresolved.
